terms.job: Signals a question about a starting point in time.
Signals a question whose precise force must be read from context.
Often points the reader toward the Mishnah and its formulation.
Signals that a biblical verse is entering as evidence.
Signals pressure on a preceding claim through a source or case.
Often introduces a distinction that resolves an apparent conflict.
Names a legal or practical status that frames later discussion.
Names an inference or line of reasoning, often distinct from a direct citation.
Signals a ruling about the described case, inviting a question about its reason.
Names evidence brought to support or test a claim.
